visual_plan: STYLE: FLAT skin, night palette (deep indigo/navy sky, charcoal hill silhouette, saffron-gold accents); counters in big gold digits with a soft glow. The reel goes night → dusk → the flame. Respectful and awe-filled throughout.

NO deity faces, idols, lingams, temple interiors or ritual close-ups; no direction/orientation trivia. Show only: the hill, the flame, crowds walking (from behind/side, simple silhouettes), buses, trains, police caps, CCTV poles, medical tents, food plates, map pin. No real logos (TNSTC, Railways) or brand names.
COUNTDOWN RAIL: 6 small lamp icons on the left edge; one lights per fact beat (L4, L5, L7, L9×2, L11); the 6th lights just before the hilltop flame.
SOURCE STRIP: 'Source: The Hindu, 23 Nov 2026' visible from L3 to the end card (small, bottom, readable).

NUMBERS ON SCREEN exactly as in Facts to verify: 50,00,000 (50 lakh, label 'expected'), 4,877 buses, 16 special trains, 15,500+ police, ~1,100 CCTV, 14 km, 120 medical camps, 288 free-food spots. Do NOT add a time ('6 PM'), hill height, ghee quantity or any other number.

Per-line: L1: COUNTER 0 → 50,00,000 (gold digits) over a wide night shot of the hill; tiny lamps of a walking crowd at its foot. TEXT HOOK on screen 0–2 s. | L2: Slow push-in on the dark hilltop (unlit). Chip: 'MAHA DEEPAM · 24 NOV 2026'. | L3: Map pin drops on 'TIRUVANNAMALAI, TAMIL NADU'. Bottom strip stays from here to the end: 'Source: The Hindu, 23 Nov 2026'. Countdown rail appears on the side: 6 empty lamp icons. | L4: COUNTER 4,877 with a stream of flat buses rolling in; then COUNTER 16 with a train sliding across. Small chip: '23–25 NOV'. Lamp 1 of 6 lights on the rail. | L5: COUNTER 15,500+ (rows of caps/badges, no faces in detail); then COUNTER ~1,100 with CCTV icons blinking on poles. Lamp 2 lights. | L6: Animated follow-button tap (Instagram) + subscribe (YouTube) in a corner while the crowd keeps walking. Keep under 3 s. | L7: COUNTER 0 → 14 KM as a glowing line draws a loop around the hill silhouette; tiny walking figures (from behind, barefoot) along it. Lamp 3 lights. | L8: Cut close to a devotee family walking (seen from the side, no deity imagery): Pinky in a small pavadai holding Ammamma's hand, a cloth bag. Pattern interrupt: first human voice after the host. | L9: COUNTER 120 with a red-cross tent icon; then COUNTER 288 with steaming banana-leaf plates. Lamps 4 and 5 light. Optional small chip: '~35 ambulances, 10 bike ambulances'. | L10: Comment-bubble icon pops up over the walking crowd; sky starts turning dusk orange. | L11: Dusk. Crowd silhouettes all turn toward the hilltop; lamp 6 on the rail lights; then the FLAME LIGHTS on the hilltop (whoosh + warm swell, 2–3 s, no voice), glow spreading down the hill. Hold. | L12: Share-arrow icon, then END CARD (@_reelrasam | YouTube @reel_rasam) over the lit hill. Loop: the last frame matches frame 1's wide hill shot, so the reel restarts on 'ఒక్క దీపం కోసం…'.
AUDIO: soft synthesized drone + temple-bell-like chime (our own synth, no recorded devotional music); counters tick; flame lighting = whoosh + warm swell with no voice for 2–3 s.
